description.value: L'ilette Boulangerie is a French-named artisan bakery on Vancouver Island's west coast, located on Second Avenue West. The name — 'ilette' (little island) and 'boulangerie' (bakery) — suggests a boutique establishment with a local identity. A touring cyclist passing through could stop for fresh bread and baked goods.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a bakery (shop=bakery) at 125 Second Avenue West with a phone number. The provided website is an Instagram profile (lilette.local), but the fetched content is entirely generic Instagram login/landing pages — the business profile itself was not accessible without authentication, so no business-specific information could be extracted. All amenity fields must default to null; only OSM tags provide any usable data.
concerns: Website is an Instagram profile; fetched content is only generic Instagram login/landing pages — no business-specific information was accessible. All amenities unverifiable from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, named bakery with a phone number and physical address on Vancouver Island; OSM shows no closure indicators. Useful food stop for touring cyclists.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tag is shop=bakery; system mapped this to Groceries. A bakery is a food stop useful to cyclists, so Groceries is an acceptable category for directory purposes, though it is not a general grocery store.
